note: TEST ONLY. Bit-accurate reference vectors for the v0.1.12 RTL relations decoder (rank 0, relations on, last-value hold). Generated by the v0.1.10 integer model (scripts/scp-v0110-int-scp4d.ts), not hand-edited; rtl_program_hex is the relation program the RTL loads (built from the model's fixed-point setup by scripts/scp-v0112-rtl-vectors.ts rtlProgram). Inputs are labelled test fixtures, not production data. Same S4DI v1 stream format as fixtures/scp/golden-vectors-scp4d.json (unchanged).
program_word: 17 hex digits = {sel[3:0], addr[15:0], data[47:0]}; sel 0 ORD {is_target, e[10:0], aux[10:0], fan_cnt[3:0]}, 1 FAN {tg[10:0], ti[9:0], W[17:0]}, 2 ACC (bias, 48-bit two's complement), 3 regs (addr 0 D, addr 1 nT)
